tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration | 5+ Years E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with proven success integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis, translating business needs into robust solutions. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Saptix Technologies’ vision to combine SAP Commerce Cloud with innovative CPQ solutions. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your platform’s growth.

bullets.label: Platform Development
bullets.text: Designed and built end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product catalog, pricing and customer data, using Java and Spring, ensuring scalability and best-practice architecture.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Created and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, streamlining data flow across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories and functional specs, leading successful releases and production support.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Ops
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, delivering reliable releases in agile DevOps pipelines.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or onsite.

tailoring.why_company: Saptix Technologies is at the forefront of extending SAP Commerce Cloud with cutting-edge CPQ capabilities, a combination that aligns perfectly with my expertise in end-to-end e-commerce platform development and complex system integrations. I am eager to join a team that drives digital transformation for global brands, leveraging my background in SAP Commerce, API design and techno-functional delivery to accelerate your product roadmap and deliver measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Saptix deliver best-in-class SAP Commerce Cloud and CPQ solutions, using my proven SAP Commerce expertise and integration experience to drive rapid, high-quality releases.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about Saptix’s SAP CPQ vision and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer role at Saptix Technologies. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development, integration and techno-functional delivery, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
